items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Frank Stokes and Dan Sane, what happened to them? [INTERVIEWEE] They died. Both of them is dead.

ctx.x: Memphis Minnie is sick. She got a stroke. She can't talk, can't walk in a wheelchair. Gee, that's terrible. Her husband also is the same way. He got a stroke. Got a stroke way before she did. The first of the winter.
And Frank Stokes and Dan Sane, what happened to them?
They died. Both of them is dead.
